name: Imagine
price: Free (donationware; $20+ donation for a personal license code)
summary: Tiny, very fast Korean-made freeware image and animation viewer for Windows with a thumbnail browser, a huge format list (incl. JXL, AVIF, HEIF, CLIP, KRA, many RAW), archive browsing, batch conversion/rename, basic paint and an animation editor. Also works as Total Commander plugins.
where_it_wins: Enormous format list incl. KRA, ORA, CLIP, DICOM, HDR formats
Editing, animation creation and batch rename built in
Runs on anything from Windows 95 to Windows 11 ARM64
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon), Honeyview/BandiView-style viewing without Windows or Wine
Plays videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI …) in the same grid and slideshow
Recursive name search with regular expressions
Mac-native keyboard-first design, dual pane, undo for file actions
